title: Scholarship and Locker
author: Zephyrine Villalobos
blurb: Theo Eastwick, the new kid at a school built over something old, is fine. Everything is fine. Obviously.. But when grandma's recipe box contains directions that aren't for food, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
